items.html: And when ZON ascend upward to the world of Atzilut and unite with Aba and Ima, which are Yod and Heh, then the eleven spices of the incense, which are the vitality of the Klipot drawn from Vav and Heh, also depart and ascend upward, and then the Klipot are nullified, and then the upper name becomes complete.
